evidence.evidence_text: We denote this phenomena as the framework tax, and observe that the disparity is growing as hardware speed increases over time.

Increased focus on the computational efficiency of systems in natural language processing has motivated the design of efficient model architectures and improvements to underlying hardware accelerators.
However, the resulting increases in computational throughput and reductions in floating point operations have not directly translated to improvements in wall-clock inference latency.
